decisions: The new lake.alpaca module uses injected AsyncTransport, sleep, and clock dependencies; the default transport is httpx.AsyncClient and no test sends a provider request.
T026 ProviderSettings request values configure concurrency, timeout, retry attempts, and Retry-After behavior through AlpacaClient.from_settings.
T021 equity trade and quote fields are represented by immutable NormalizedTrade and NormalizedQuote records with UTC timestamps and Decimal prices.
Each symbol is paginated sequentially, symbol jobs run under one bounded semaphore, cursor tokens are propagated exactly once per page, and repeated cursors fail explicitly.
Retryable transport failures and HTTP 408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504 responses use bounded exponential backoff; 429 Retry-After supports seconds and HTTP-date values.
limitations: The shared worktree contains unrelated changes in other files; they were not modified, staged, reverted, or committed by this task.
API credentials are deferred: the client accepts optional runtime api_key and api_secret values and T026 SecretStr settings, but credentials are not committed, resolved, or exercised.
No live Alpaca/provider calls, credentials, network access, or MyPy run were used.
